summary: Frontend mobile E2E and focused backend regression completed. New CPF registration, admin login/approval for 7 days, approved driver login, dashboard rendering, preview mode, and account navigation were exercised.
action_items: Optional: add an explicit account-screen assertion only if the test contract requires a different testID; the implemented screen currently exposes data-testid=conta-screen and rendered correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: No critical issues found in the reviewed auth, admin, dashboard, or account code paths.

success_rate.frontend: 100% core flow; 1 assertion used an incorrect expected selector

seed_data_creation: Created one TEST-style CPF through the public UI flow (153.509.460-56), approved for 7 days, and retained it for the app flow; no destructive cleanup was performed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public preview URL tested at /login with mobile viewport 375x667. Web correctly shows Modo prévia because native accessibility module is unavailable. Account screen testID is conta-screen, not account-screen.
rca_of_issue: The only reported automation finding was a test expectation mismatch: the test waited for data-testid=account-screen, while frontend/app/conta.tsx correctly declares testID=conta-screen. Screenshot confirmed the account screen rendered with Sair and Excluir conta e dados actions; this is not a product defect.
